context: Tests whether the agent conducts Phase 1 correctly: asking the team, lens and problem questions one at a time, pushing back on a user who lists three ideas, matching a lens, recommending a build tool for a mostly non-coding team, and enforcing the exit gate.

checklist.name: Phase announcement
checklist.description: The coach explicitly announces Phase 1 (e.g. 'Phase 1 — Interrogate') before or at the first question

checklist.name: Questions one at a time
checklist.description: The team, lens and problem questions are asked in separate turns, not bundled into one message

checklist.name: Team question handled
checklist.description: The coach confirms each teammate's role (builder, domain expert, storyteller) as its own turn, acknowledging what Léa already said

checklist.name: Lens question asked
checklist.description: The coach asks the team to pick public policy or business as the judging lens, and states there are no tracks

checklist.name: Problem question asked
checklist.description: The coach asks for one problem in one sentence naming who suffers and when

checklist.name: Pushback on multiple ideas
checklist.description: Because Léa lists three ideas, the coach explicitly pushes back and makes the team pick exactly one

checklist.name: Tool recommended
checklist.description: The coach recommends a primary build tool (Lovable or Claude Code) with a one-line reason tied to the team's skills

checklist.name: Exit gate verified
checklist.description: The log marks Phase 1 complete and lists team roles with a tool, a single lens and a single named problem before moving on

checklist.name: Voice and tone
checklist.description: Messages are short and direct, with no apology for pushing back

checklist.name: No building advice
checklist.description: The coach gives no code, file structures or implementation steps
